real_qa.q: What is SpinFire and why is it essential for automotive suppliers working with multiple CAD formats?
real_qa.r: SpinFire is Actify's CAD visualization product that has been on the market for many years with over 2,000 organizations using it. It is essential because automotive suppliers receive incoming CAD in multiple formats from OEMs, who collectively use every major CAD system. SpinFire provides an easy and cost-effective way for suppliers to access and work with customer information across different formats.

real_qa.q: How do Actify's automation pipelines reduce time in the CAD data processing workflow for automotive suppliers?
real_qa.r: Actify's pipelines automate the manual file conversion process that engineers were spending significant time on daily. By setting up rules specific to each customer that automatically unpack and route incoming data to the right people, suppliers can get customer information into the right hands 48 hours sooner. This 48-hour acceleration represents approximately 20 percent of the 10 business days typically given to respond to customer changes, allowing engineers more time to do better work.
real_qa.requete: Actify automation pipelines CAD file conversion time savings

real_qa.q: What are the major challenges facing automotive suppliers in the electric vehicle transition era?
real_qa.r: The automotive industry is experiencing a once-in-a-century transformation driven by electrification and new manufacturing paradigms. Suppliers face multiple challenges including simplified platforms (GM reduced from 550 to 19 platforms), massively compressed product timelines (BYD launches vehicles in six months versus the traditional three years), and entirely new engineering requirements such as handling instant torque from electric motors that destroys traditional shafts and axles. Additionally, suppliers must meet increasing efficiency demands (BMW requiring 99.8 percent drivetrain efficiency) while reducing weight and noise, all while managing files and processes from diverse global OEMs using different systems.
real_qa.requete: automotive EV suppliers challenges electric vehicle production

real_qa.q: How does enterprise-wide SpinFire licensing expand CAD visualization access beyond engineering teams?
real_qa.r: Enterprise licensing of SpinFire puts the application on every employee's desktop, enabling purchasing, finance, quality, marketing, sales, HR, and facilities departments to access and view CAD data without needing to be trained CAD users. During COVID, HR and facilities departments used SpinFire to view floor plans for social distancing compliance and to access emergency procedures documentation for audits, eliminating the need to find an engineer to interpret CAD files for non-technical users.
real_qa.requete: enterprise SpinFire license non-engineers CAD access

real_qa.q: What is Actify's hybrid cloud strategy for managing on-premise and cloud-based CAD data?
real_qa.r: Actify has developed sophisticated hybrid capabilities that isolate the visualization user from needing to know where files are located. Behind the scenes, the system can access files from PLM systems, PDM systems, SharePoint, local Z drives, or native cloud storage, with on-premise servers dedicated to specific OEM customers that maintain strict check-in and check-out rules. The user experience is unified—they simply request to see a file and Actify handles all searching, security, and contingency management in the background.
real_qa.requete: Actify hybrid cloud on-premise CAD data strategy

real_qa.q: Why does the automotive industry structure with OEMs and suppliers create high demand for CAD visualization tools?
real_qa.r: OEMs like Ford, Tesla, and BMW design vehicles but outsource the majority of part production to hundreds of suppliers across each program. With 20,000 to 40,000 parts in an automobile, suppliers receive incoming CAD daily in multiple formats from their customers. Since OEMs collectively use every major CAD system, suppliers need a universal tool like SpinFire to cost-effectively access and manage this high volume of diverse customer information.
real_qa.requete: automotive OEM supplier CAD format requirements
